propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate built the Java order-routing service that splits retail orders across two execution venues.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the service and its language directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran quarterly failover drills for the order-routing service and recorded recovery times in the resilience log.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the drills and the engineering manager confirmed them in writing.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has worked at staff engineer level for the last three years.
propositions.rationale: The staff-engineer description is the candidate's own wording in a covering email ('effectively'), with no title, promotion or documented scope behind it; the employer confirmed the level Software Engineer II, and the qualification rule forbids inferring seniority beyond explicit cited evidence.

expectedGap: No record documents staff-level scope; the employer-confirmed level is Software Engineer II, and the staff-engineer description comes from the candidate's covering email.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the employer-confirmed level and the documented routing, design-review, failover and coaching work; do not describe the candidate as having worked at staff engineer level.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask which cross-team technical decisions the candidate personally made in the last three years and whether the previous employer recorded any staff-level scope or promotion.
